name: Looper
about: Loop of layers from the microphone
hint: Tap — record the first loop. Tap again — the loop plays, then every tap adds a layer. Hold — undo a layer. Headphones: without them the mic hears the speaker.
hintMore: Tap — new layer on top. Hold — undo the last one.
hintShort: Tap — record, again — loop, then — layers
metro: With metronome: one-bar count-in, length in whole bars
monOn: Microphone in the speakers — better with headphones
saved: Mix saved to the media library
err.sound: Sound did not start — tap again
help.what: Looper: record a loop and play over it.
help.1: One button: record → loop → layer → done.
help.2: With the metronome — count-in, length in whole bars.
help.3: Hold the button — undo a layer; four loops below.
help.4: Bluetooth pedal: Space or PageDown — button, PageUp — stop.
